description: The Warp Agent CLI and Kilo CLI through their vendors' installers on Windows, installed and not run.
why: Nothing else here names either agent, so Kilo's witness is ~\.kilo\ alone, and Warp's are the two things its CLI installer writes, each held by require_rows: the launcher under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Warp\bin\ and its Uninstall key. hermes is forbidden because its launcher is read by the same per-user branch; opencode because Kilo's CLI forks it and its installer writes the same shape of directory; cline and roo-code because Kilo Code forks them.
known_gaps: Installed, never run, and never signed in: what either CLI writes on first use is not read here.
